TIME-BOUND EXPANSION OF CITY GAS DISTRIBUTION NETWORK BY 
INDRAPRASTHA GAS LIMITED
details:
PNGRB has authorized total 12 Nos of Geographical Areas (GAs) to Indraprastha Gas Limited 
(IGL) with Minimum Work Programme (MWP) targets of providing 27,70,123 Domestic PNG 
Connections, establishing 408 CNG Stations and laying 13,525 Inch-KM of pipeline by 2030.
